title: theme v0
description: The theme block of a plugin of kind theme (ADR 0056, docs/ko/theme-requirements.md): six layers of values that the runtime compiles into the desk's --desk-* tokens, plus terminal colours. A theme runs no code and asks for no permission; every layer has a default, so a theme with a palette alone is complete.

ThemePackage.description: A theme: the layers every scheme shares (type, shape, motion) and one variant per scheme. At least one of light and dark; the desk's own theme stands in for a missing one.

license.description: An SPDX licence expression for the theme and its assets, for example CC0-1.0 or OFL-1.1.

tags.description: Words a gallery filters by, for example warm, paper or high-contrast.

preview.description: Up to five colours that stand for the theme on a gallery card, the most telling first. Taken from the variants when absent.

ThemeBundle.description: A theme as one file, a .desk-theme: JSON, 16 MiB at most, holding the theme's plugin.json and the font and image files its theme block names, base64. theme.export writes one and theme.import reads one; the desk checks it as a theme plugin folder before it lands.

format.description: The bundle format and its version.

manifest.description: The theme's plugin.json: a plugin of kind theme.

files.description: The theme's font and image files by their path in its folder, each base64. Only the paths its theme block names.

ThemeAssetPath.description: A theme's font (.woff2) or image (.png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp) file relative to its folder, without .. segments.

ThemeAssetData.description: One asset file's bytes in padded base64 (RFC 4648): 2 MiB of bytes at most.

ThemeOrigin.description: Where a theme came from: the sentence it was described with, and the theme it started from.

ThemeVariant.description: One scheme's values: its palette (and high-contrast palette), material, backdrop and terminal colours.

contrast.description: The palette's changes under high contrast. When absent the desk derives them from the palette, so the theme keeps its character at 7:1.

ThemeColors.description: Token name (camelCase, as in @endue-ai/ui: background, text, primary, chart1, the shell's and Eris's tokens) to a value. Missing roles keep the desk's.

ThemeValue.description: A CSS value for one token: a colour, or a shadow for the shadow tokens. No url(), braces, semicolons or angle brackets.

ThemeColor.description: A CSS colour: #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla() or oklch().

ThemeMaterial.description: What surfaces are made of: how opaque, how much they blur what is behind, grain, edge and elevation.

opacity.description: Surface opacity, 0.6 to 1 (default 1). Below 1 the backdrop shows through, blurred.

ThemeShadow.description: Elevation: none, soft (the default) or strong. Shadow tokens in colors win.

ThemeBackdrop.description: What the desk shows behind its windows: a colour, a gradient or an image, and the glow at the top.

gradient.description: Two to four colours, drawn as a linear gradient at angle.

ThemeImageFit.description: cover fills the desk with the image; tile repeats it at its own size.

ThemeTerminal.description: The terminal's sixteen ANSI colours, black to bright white.

ThemeType.description: Typefaces and the type scale, shared by both schemes.

tracking.description: Letter spacing of body text in em, -0.02 to 0.05 (default 0).

fonts.description: Font files the theme brings, loaded for the shell and every plugin page.

ThemeFontStack.description: A CSS font-family list, for example "Literata", Georgia, serif.

ThemeFont.description: One font file of the theme.

weight.description: A weight or a variable font's range, for example 400 or 200 900.

ThemeFontPath.description: A .woff2 file relative to the plugin folder, without .. segments.

ThemeImagePath.description: A .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp file relative to the plugin folder, without .. segments.

ThemeShape.description: Corner and density presets, shared by both schemes.

ThemeRadius.description: none (square), subtle (2, 4, 6 px), soft (4, 8, 12 px, the default) or round (6, 12, 18 px) for the small, medium and large radius.

ThemeDensity.description: Control heights: compact (24 to 44 px), comfortable (28 to 48 px, the default) or spacious (32 to 52 px).

ThemeMotion.description: How things move, shared by both schemes. Reduced motion still stops everything.

ThemeMotionPersonality.description: snappy (short, sharp), smooth (the default) or calm (long, gentle).
